Name: Gath-rimmon
ModernLocation: Unknown; the name belongs to more than one town, in Dan, Ephraim, and Manasseh
Description: The name belongs to more than one town: one in Dan's allotment and Levitical cities in Ephraim and Manasseh. All appear only in the allotment and Levitical lists, and no site is identified.
BiblicalSignificance: Gath-rimmon is shared by Dan's town and Levitical cities in Ephraim and Manasseh.
